patch_description: Replace the current seeded random point generator with a deterministic Heilbronn optimizer. It builds multiple structured initializations (regular 13-gon, 12-gon + center, concentric rings, seeded uniform random), refines each with smooth-surrogate (LogSumExp soft-min) gradient ascent with analytic gradients and an annealed temperature schedule, then polishes with greedy coordinate hill-climbing on the exact minimum triangle area. The best configuration (by min_area / hull_area) is rescaled so its convex hull has unit area. Fully deterministic via fixed seeds.
